# Tatoeba fixture

Hand-written excerpt in the format of the Tatoeba exports (jpn_sentences, eng_sentences,
jpn-eng_links, jpn_indices), uncompressed. Sentence IDs and text are invented for the tests;
real Tatoeba sentences are CC BY 2.0 FR, attributed per sentence at https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/<id>.
The words match test/fixtures/jmdict-excerpt.xml.
